description: You are using Aerobridge, an open-source drone/UAV fleet management system. Your task is to add a new drone company/manufacturer to the registry. Log in to the admin panel at http://localhost:8000/admin/ using username 'admin' and password 'adminpass123'. In the Registry section, find 'Companys' (this is the company/manufacturer registry) and click '+ Add'. Fill in the required fields: (1) Full Name: 'SkyTech Innovations', (2) Common Name: any short name (e.g. 'SkyTech'), (3) Website: any valid URL (e.g. 'https://skytech.in'), (4) Email: any valid email (e.g. 'info@skytech.in'), (5) Documents: in the Documents list widget, select 'Default Aerobridge Document' by clicking on it, (6) Country: select 'India' (IN) from the dropdown (it may already default to India). Click Save to register the company. Do not log out after saving.
